verses.text: For the one directing. Of the sons of Korah. A Maskil. O God, with our ears we have heard; our fathers have recounted to us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.

verses.text: You, with Your hand, dispossessed the nations, and You planted them; You afflicted the peoples and sent them forth.

verses.text: For they did not gain possession of the land by their sword, and their arm did not bring salvation to them; but [it was] Your right hand, and Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You delighted in them.

verses.text: You are my King, O God; Command deliverances for Jacob.

segments.text: You are my King, O God; Command deliverances for Jacob.

verses.text: Through You we push back our adversaries; by Your name we trample those rising against us.

verses.text: For not in my bow do I trust, and my sword will not save me.

verses.text: For You have saved us from our adversaries, and those hating us, You have put to shame.

verses.text: In God we have boasted all the day, and we will praise Your name forever. Selah

verses.text: You make us turn back from the adversary, and those hating us have taken plunder for themselves.

verses.text: Rouse Yourself! Why do You sleep, O Lord? Awake! Do not reject [us] forever.
